name: Aishite Nightingale
original_name: 愛してナイチンゲール
source:
Main character gets his body replaced with his sister with the power of magical medicine. A large amount of "pure virgin libido power" is needed to return to the original state, as family doctor says.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角利用魔药的力量，将自己的身体替换成了姐姐的身体。正如家庭医生所说，需要大量的“纯处女性欲之力”才能恢复到原来的状态。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
